reasons: Six required courses remain (CS4261, CS4278, CS2105, CS2102, CS3219, CS4350), all 4 MC. With a maximum of 4 MC per semester, at least six semesters are needed, but only semesters 5-8 (four semesters) remain.
CS4278 requires CS3263 or CS3243. CS3243 is blocked by completed CS2109S, so CS3263 must be planned first. CS4278 is offered only in Sem 1, so its earliest possible placement is semester 7.

CS4350 requires CS3247 (or NM3216/NM4260/NM4260HM), none completed. The earliest chain is CS3241 in semester 5, CS3247 in semester 6, then CS4350 in semester 7. Thus CS4350 also earliest possible in semester 7.
CS4278 and CS4350 would both need to be placed in semester 7, but the 4 MC per semester limit allows only one 4 MC course in that semester. Therefore no valid plan exists.
